config.description: Distilled student on dozken's reset2k architecture. 2x160 GRU with a 64-unit GELU+LayerNorm input projection over concat[normalised, first differences] and a LayerNorm+GELU MLP head over concat[h2, projection], periodic state reset every 2,000 rows. Trained against dozken's own 0.6569 model replayed as exact teacher labels, so it inherits a base 0.0083 stronger than ours without ever running that model at inference.
config.hypothesis: Two independent gaps, addressed together. (1) Teacher: his model scores 0.690168 on our full validation against v017's 0.681866, +0.0083, and we already extract more from distillation than he does (+0.0027 vs +0.0019), so his base plus our process should land near or past his 0.6588. (2) Latency: v021 at 435,714 params projects to 58-70 min on the grader, 97-116% of the 60-min target, which is unshippable. 314,338 params is the size that matched his best entry at 55m16s, so this trades capacity for headroom we can actually ship. Smaller students beating their teachers is his own reported effect (distil160 0.6888 > 0.6879).
config.change_vs_parent: Parent v021 shrunk to hidden 160 (435,714 -> ~314,338 params, matching his distil160) and given distillation: distill_weight 0->0.5, teacher_labels [] -> cache/teacher/teacher_dozken_reset2k.npy, generated by replaying his reset2k ONNX through onnxruntime so the labels are exact rather than a torch approximation. Everything else identical to v021, so the two differ in size and teacher only.
